title: Page and Layout params prop is now asynchronous in Next.js 16
description: In Next.js 16, params passed to Pages, Layouts, generateMetadata, and Route Handlers is a Promise. Synchronously accessing properties on params without await or React.use() is deprecated and causes runtime failures.

remediation.summary: Await params before accessing properties, e.g. const { slug } = await params;

title: searchParams prop is now asynchronous in Next.js 16
description: In Next.js 16, searchParams passed to Server Component pages is a Promise. Accessing properties synchronously without await is deprecated.

remediation.summary: Await searchParams before accessing query parameters.

title: middleware convention replaced by proxy in Next.js 16
description: The middleware.ts / middleware.js convention has been deprecated in favor of proxy.ts / proxy.js network boundary handlers running on the Node.js runtime.

remediation.summary: Rename middleware.ts to proxy.ts and update export function middleware to export function proxy.

title: AMP support has been completely removed in Next.js 16
description: Next.js 16 completely removed Accelerated Mobile Pages (AMP) support and the useAmp hook from next/amp.

remediation.summary: Remove imports from 'next/amp' and replace AMP markup with standard responsive HTML/CSS.

title: unstable_cache is deprecated in favor of 'use cache' in Next.js 16
description: Next.js 16 introduces Cache Components with the 'use cache' directive. The unstable_cache helper from next/cache is deprecated.

remediation.summary: Adopt the 'use cache' directive with cacheLife() instead of unstable_cache().
remediation.exampleBefore:
import { unstable_cache } from 'next/cache';

const getCachedData = unstable_cache(async () => fetchDb(), ['data-key']);

title: revalidateTag profile changes in Next.js 16
description: In Next.js 16 Cache Components model, revalidateTag is complemented or replaced by updateTag() and cacheTag() for granular invalidation.

remediation.summary: Review revalidateTag usage and migrate to updateTag or cacheTag for Cache Components.

title: serverRuntimeConfig and publicRuntimeConfig removed from next.config.js
description: serverRuntimeConfig and publicRuntimeConfig are removed in Next.js 16. Standard environment variables (process.env and NEXT_PUBLIC_) should be used instead.

remediation.summary: Remove serverRuntimeConfig and access process.env directly.

title: Custom webpack config in next.config.js with Turbopack as default
description: Turbopack is the default bundler in Next.js 16. Custom webpack configuration in next.config.js will not apply to Turbopack without explicit turbopack config or running next build --webpack.

remediation.summary: Configure turbopack in next.config.js, or run builds with --webpack flag.

title: Edge runtime on middleware/proxy deprecated in Next.js 16
description: In Next.js 16, proxy handlers run exclusively on the Node.js runtime to streamline architecture and network boundaries. export const runtime = 'edge' is no longer supported for proxy/middleware.

remediation.summary: Remove export const runtime = 'edge' from your proxy / middleware file.
remediation.exampleBefore:
export const runtime = 'edge';
export function middleware() { ... }

title: getInitialProps is deprecated in Next.js 16
description: getInitialProps in the Pages Router is deprecated. Migrate to getServerSideProps, getStaticProps, or App Router Server Components.

remediation.summary: Replace getInitialProps with getServerSideProps or migrate page to the App Router.
